title: 2BR Seacrest Beach Vacation Rental Close to Lagoon Pool
meta_description: Lagoon Lounge, a 2BR, 3BA Seacrest Beach vacation rental, with a private patio, access to the lagoon pool, a full kitchen, and private beach access. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love • Located in Seacrest Beach, on the North side of Scenic 30A • Private ground-level patio with direct access to lagoon pool • Three bedrooms, each with a king-size bed • Two ensuite bathrooms plus one hallway full bath • Fully equipped kitchen with bar seating and beverage fridge • Dedicated coffee bar with Keurig and drip maker • Cozy indoor fireplace • Washer and dryer in unit • Free private parking for up to three vehicles • Wheelchair accessible (single-level living) • Short walk to private beach accessWelcome to Lagoon Lounge, a stylish and serene ground-level getaway perfectly positioned in Seacrest Beach on the North side of Scenic 30A, just steps from the iconic 12,000 sq. ft. lagoon-style pool. With designer comfort, private beach access, and a layout designed for both relaxation and togetherness, this three-bedroom condo offers an ideal coastal escape for families or couples traveling together.Inside, you're welcomed into a bright open-concept living, dining, and kitchen space filled with natural light and thoughtful finishes. The cozy living area features a sectional sofa, flat-screen TV, and access to cable and Wi-Fi—perfect for movie nights or quiet mornings. Adjacent is a dining table with seating for six, while the chef-ready kitchen includes stainless steel appliances, a flat-top stove, microwave, dishwasher, and bar seating. A dedicated coffee bar with both a Keurig and traditional drip machine, plus a beverage fridge, adds a luxurious touch to your daily routine.All three bedrooms are furnished with plush king-size beds, offering stylish comfort and privacy. Two of the bedrooms feature private ensuite bathrooms with walk-in showers, while the third uses a nearby hallway bathroom with a tub/shower combination—ideal for families with children. Each room is finished with coastal décor, quality linens, ceiling fans, and smart storage. A laundry closet with a washer, dryer, iron, and ironing board provides added convenience for longer stays.Step outside to your private patio, where you'll find direct access to Seacrest’s lagoon-style pool—a resort-style centerpiece with lush landscaping, multiple fountains, and ample lounge space. Whether you're swimming, sunbathing, or enjoying a quiet afternoon cocktail, the outdoor area blends tropical flair with total relaxation. Guests also have access to a community grill station, outdoor shower, and the neighborhood’s private beach access via a scenic walking path—less than five minutes from your door.HOME LAYOUT: (Sleeps 8)GROUND FLOOR UNIT • Open living area with sectional seating and flat-screen TV • Dining table with seating for 6 • Fully stocked kitchen with stainless appliances and bar seating • Coffee bar with Keurig, drip machine, and beverage fridge • King bedroom with ensuite bathroom (walk-in shower & Deep Style Tub) (Sleeps 2) • King bedroom with ensuite bathroom (walk-in shower) (Sleeps 2) • King bedroom with hallway bathroom (tub/shower combo) (Sleeps 2) • Twin Bunkbed set in Hallway (Sleeps 2) • Laundry closet with washer and dryer, iron, and ironing board • Private patio with lagoon pool access • Community grill, outdoor shower, and beach path • Free parking for 1 Vehicle • 4 Complimentary Bikes Included
